_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Education-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

FUNDING_CRISIS.education_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Chronic underfunding of public education creating resource scarcity, facility deterioration, and inability to attract or retain qualified educators"
FUNDING_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is a THROUGHPUT GATE stuck closed. A gate stuck closed producing downstream resource starvation is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation) verbatim — the funding gate closes and the system (classrooms, materials, staff, libraries) is starved. Strongest grounding of the set: the cue text literally reads 'stuck-closed=starvation'.
FUNDING_CRISIS.note: The _authored circuit realizes this as five hypo-active downstream nodes (vmPFC, dlPFC, BROCA, SMA, PRECUNEUS) all starved by the closed funding gate.

TEACHER_SHORTAGE.education_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; summary: "Critical shortage of qualified teachers driven by low compensation, burnout, and declining enrollment in education preparation programs"
TEACHER_SHORTAGE.reasoning: Classified on the canonical NODE cue, which is IDENTICAL to FUNDING_CRISIS: a gating relay stuck closed starving the system (here, of qualified teachers) = GATING_FAILURE (gate stuck closed -> starvation).
TEACHER_SHORTAGE.note: TWO divergences flagged, not resolved by guessing. (1) The SUMMARY describes a supply/workforce DEPLETION (a resource-exhaustion flavor) rather than a routing-gate lock; the gate cue governs the class, but the depletion flavor has no clean dedicated analog among the 9. (2) This issue's _authored circuit [BROCA, SMA, TPJ, OXY] FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (no regulatory partner) — see incomplete_circuit_diagnostic. The failure-class map and the incomplete-circuit test are independent diagnostics; here they disagree (a classifiable GATING_FAILURE that is nonetheless an INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT structurally).

ACHIEVEMENT_GAP.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
ACHIEVEMENT_GAP.education_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; summary: "Persistent disparities in educational outcomes across racial, socioeconomic, and geographic lines reflecting structural inequity in resource distribution and opportunity access"; authored dACC[Altered]: "Assessment systems detecting gaps but institutional response mechanisms failing to close them"
ACHIEVEMENT_GAP.reasoning: The canonical cue 'priors-too-strong' in an OVER-active (Hyper) conflict/error monitor is a PREDICTIVE-CODING pathology (XIII.5): over-precise top-down priors suppress bottom-up prediction error and block updating, so the system persists in an entrenched wrong state despite detection ('detecting gaps but failing to close them'). The 9 Part XIV classes are all E/I-dynamics archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); NONE expresses rigid/over-precise priors or a failure-to-update. It is not SEIZURE (no runaway excitation), not DISINHIBITION (that is LOSS of a brake; here the top-down prior is EXCESSIVE, the opposite), and dACC is not a thalamocortical gate so GATING_FAILURE is a category mismatch. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
ACHIEVEMENT_GAP.note: First of TWO Education UNMAPPED findings, and a DIFFERENT gap than Finance's: the taxonomy lacks a predictive-coding prior-rigidity / failed-update class. (Independently, this is the only Education issue with catchAllBlocked:false in education-pulse-engine.js.)

ACCREDITATION_FAILURE.subtype: monitor-down -> lost quality brake releases pathological activity
ACCREDITATION_FAILURE.education_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hypo]: "conflict/error monitor — noise-chase"; summary: "Breakdown of quality assurance mechanisms allowing credential inflation, diploma mills, and programs that fail to produce competent graduates"; authored dACC[Hypo]: "Assessment standards weakened by grade inflation and lowered rigor, masking actual learning deficits"
ACCREDITATION_FAILURE.reasoning: The conflict/error monitor is HYPO-active (down). The dACC functions as the quality/error brake; its loss releases pathological activity — credential inflation, diploma mills, unchecked low-quality programs. Losing the inhibitor/monitor and releasing pathological activity is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Grounded in dir=Hypo (monitor down) + the summary's 'allowing... credential inflation, diploma mills'.
ACCREDITATION_FAILURE.note: Straddles GATING_FAILURE: the node cue word 'noise-chase' (chasing noise = a signal/noise filtering failure) supports a filtering-gate reading. Classed as DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME on the dominant mechanism — a DOWN monitor whose lost brake releases pathological activity — with the GATING_FAILURE filter-reading recorded as the divergence.

TECHNOLOGY_DISRUPTION.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
TECHNOLOGY_DISRUPTION.education_text: canonical circuit dlPFC[Hyper]: "dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control — rigidity/rumination-lock"; summary: "Rapid AI and digital technology advancement destabilizing traditional educational models, assessment integrity, and the definition of essential human skills"; authored dACC[Altered]: "Assessment validity undermined by AI-generated student work that evades plagiarism detection"
TECHNOLOGY_DISRUPTION.reasoning: The summary and authored cues describe a MODEL-DRIFT + ADVERSARIAL-EVASION failure: the environment/model itself drifts ('destabilizing traditional educational models... the definition of essential human skills') and an adversary defeats the integrity check ('AI-generated student work that evades plagiarism detection'). These are information-integrity / adversarial-deception archetypes. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes; none expresses model-drift or fabricated/adversarial content. Forcing it would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline. (The dlPFC node cue 'rigidity/rumination-lock' could be read toward OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY over-coupling/hypersynchrony, but the governing issue-level mechanism named by the summary is model-drift + adversarial evasion, which dominates and is unmappable.)
TECHNOLOGY_DISRUPTION.note: Second UNMAPPED finding and the KEY HETEROGENEITY: this is the Education analog of Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL — an adversarial-deception / information-integrity failure (here compounded by model-drift) that the E/I-dynamics neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against education.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list). Verdicts below are the actual output of running assets/js/energy-neuro-substrate.js validateIncompleteCircuit() over education.json issues[].
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS 4/5, INCOMPLETE 1/5. Four authored circuits include at least one regulatory/feedback node; TEACHER_SHORTAGE does NOT. This DIFFERS from Finance (6/6) and Energy (6/6): Education contains a genuinely incomplete circuit. TEACHER_SHORTAGE's _authored circuit [BROCA, SMA, TPJ, OXY] is all executor/social-bonding nodes with no vmPFC/dlPFC/OFC/STN/GP/HIPP/HYPO/dACC/CBLM brake — an excitation-side mapping authored without its regulatory arm.

TEACHER_SHORTAGE.observation: THE KEY FINDING. No node in [BROCA, SMA, TPJ, OXY] is in REGULATORY_NODES. Per Part XIV a circuit built without its regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition). This authored circuit is lesioned in exactly that way. To complete it, author a regulatory partner (e.g. vmPFC policy brake or dACC monitor) into the circuit before treating it as sound.

ACHIEVEMENT_GAP.observation: Structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test, yet UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (predictive-coding prior-rigidity). The two diagnostics are independent: a circuit can be complete and still express a failure archetype outside the 9-class taxonomy.

ACCREDITATION_FAILURE.observation: The single regulatory partner (dACC) is itself the HYPO-active node driving the DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME class — the brake is present in the circuit but failing, which is why the issue still expresses pathology despite a 'complete' verdict.

TECHNOLOGY_DISRUPTION.observation: Structurally complete, yet UNMAPPED in the failure-class map (model-drift + adversarial evasion). Complete-and-unmapped, like Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Education mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. classroom-cycle vs accreditation/policy-cycle), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
